brief.aim: The table was assembled to predict whether a client subscribes to a term deposit, so y is the single binary target; call duration is only known after the call ends and is a classic leak, and campaign/previous-contact fields (pdays, previous, poutcome) reflect post-contact or prior-campaign knowledge that must be watched during validation.
brief.repeated_subjects: Clients may be contacted multiple times across the campaign; no client key is present to verify repetition.
brief.unit: One outbound marketing contact (call) with a client
